description: Consolidated evidence matrix, GO decision table and C2 comparison panel assembled from values computed earlier in this job
code:
# Consolidation artifacts. All numbers below are values computed in earlier
# execute_code calls in this job (Foldseek + Kabsch superposition, strict
# carboxylate-oxygen counts, Shrake-Rupley SASA, Gotoh/BLOSUM62 conservation).
# Nothing here is re-derived or invented; this call assembles them into tables
# and re-runs the statistics on the recorded counts.
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
pd.set_option('display.width',200); pd.set_option('display.max_colwidth',60)

panel = pd.DataFrame([
 # pdb, protein, class, carboxylate O within 8 A of site I, K/R in 15 A cap, hydrophobic in 15 A cap
 ('7JOF','dysferlin C2A','Ca2+-dependent',10,5,13),
 ('1A25','PKCbeta C2','Ca2+-dependent',10,3,12),
 ('1W15','synaptotagmin-4 C2B','Ca2+-dependent',7,4,11),
 ('5A52','Dictyostelium CAR1 C2','Ca2+-dependent',11,4,12),
 ('6EEL','myoferlin C2A','Ca2+-dependent',6,np.nan,np.nan),
 ('6NYC','Munc13-1 C2B','Ca2+-dependent',11,3,14),
 ('7AS6','plant E-Syt1 C2A','Ca2+-dependent',9,6,15),
 ('2ISD','PLCdelta1 C2','Ca2+-dependent',8,6,12),
 ('2NQ3','Itch C2','Ca2+-independent',0,4,10),
 ('5VLR','PI3Kdelta C2','Ca2+-independent',2,4,11),
 ('1GMI','PKCepsilon C2','Ca2+-independent',5,4,12),
 ('AF-Q9BPU9','B9D2 (model)','B9-type',2,2,10),
 ('AF-Q9NXB0','B9D1 (model)','B9-type',5,np.nan,np.nan),
 ('AF-Q9NXB0_MKS1','MKS1 (model)','B9-type',3,np.nan,np.nan),
], columns=['pdb','protein','class','carboxylO_8A','basic_cap_15A','hydrophobic_cap_15A'])

dep = panel.loc[panel['class']=='Ca2+-dependent','carboxylO_8A']
ind = panel.loc[panel['class']=='Ca2+-independent','carboxylO_8A']
b9  = panel.loc[panel['class']=='B9-type','carboxylO_8A']
u1,p1 = stats.mannwhitneyu(dep,b9,alternative='greater')
u2,p2 = stats.mannwhitneyu(dep,ind,alternative='greater')
print('Carboxylate oxygens within 8 A of the C2 Ca2+ site I')
print('  Ca2+-dependent  n=%d median %.1f  range %d-%d'%(len(dep),dep.median(),dep.min(),dep.max()))
print('  Ca2+-independent n=%d median %.1f range %d-%d'%(len(ind),ind.median(),ind.min(),ind.max()))
print('  B9-type          n=%d median %.1f range %d-%d'%(len(b9),b9.median(),b9.min(),b9.max()))
print('  dependent > B9-type:          U=%.0f p=%.4f'%(u1,p1))
print('  dependent > Ca2+-independent: U=%.0f p=%.4f'%(u2,p2))
print()

go = pd.DataFrame([
 ('GO:0008289','lipid binding','MF','absent','do not add','2 carboxylate O at the Ca2+ site vs median 9.5 in Ca2+-dependent C2 (p=0.0092); 2 basic residues in the 15 A cap, fewest in an 11-structure panel; no lipid assay for any human B9 protein','lead: leave absent'),
 ('GO:0005509','calcium ion binding','MF','absent','do not add','Ca2+-ligand positions not conserved (mean identity 0.43 vs 0.59 elsewhere, p=0.037); only D84 retained and it is salt-bridged to R88 at 2.74 A','lead: leave absent'),
 ('GO:0005543','phospholipid binding','MF','absent','do not add','same structural evidence; PF07162 and IPR010796 carry no GO terms so there is no InterPro2GO path','lead: leave absent'),
 ('GO:0016020','membrane','CC','present, IEA GO_REF:0000107 only','candidate for removal or replacement','no experimental support; the B9 complex reaches the TZ membrane by anchoring TMEM67 (PMID:41165761), so GO:0035869 ciliary transition zone already captures the location','lead requiring curator verification'),
 ('GO:0036038','MKS complex','CC','present (IBA, ISS, NAS PMID:22179047)','retain, core','interdependent MKS1-B9D2-B9D1 assembly (PMID:32726168); consistent with a scaffold role','retain'),
 ('GO:0035869','ciliary transition zone','CC','present (NAS PMID:22179047)','retain, core; IDA upgrade possible','PMID:41165761 localises B9 proteins to the TZ and to centrioles before ciliogenesis','lead: check for IDA-grade reference'),
 ('GO:0032182','ubiquitin-like protein binding / protein-containing complex scaffold activity family','MF','absent','consider a scaffold-flavoured MF only if a curator finds direct evidence','B9D2 MF is currently only GO:0005515 protein binding (7 IPI records); no better-supported MF term identified','lead: no confident MF replacement'),
 ('GO:1904491','protein localization to ciliary transition zone','BP','present (NAS PMID:22179047)','retain','TMEM67 anchoring (PMID:41165761) and interdependent TZ localisation (PMID:32726168) give mechanism','retain'),
], columns=['GO_id','term','aspect','current_status_on_Q9BPU9','recommended_action','basis','label'])

ev = pd.DataFrame([
 ('this work (Foldseek + Kabsch, AF-Q9BPU9-F1)','structural/computational','refutes','B9D2 retains the C2 Ca2+-ligand cluster','Core RMSD 1.54-1.67 A to four Ca2+-bound C2 domains over 50-76 Calpha; 7 of 8 mapped Ca2+ ions fall in one 6 A cluster; B9D2 has 2 carboxylate O within 8 A vs median 9.5 for Ca2+-dependent C2 (Mann-Whitney p=0.0092)','human B9D2 AlphaFold model, mean pLDDT 89.6','high for the fold assignment; model-based, no experimental B9D2 structure'),
 ('this work (Gotoh/BLOSUM62, 16 orthologues)','evolutionary/computational','refutes','Ca2+-ligand positions are conserved across ciliated eukaryotes','Ca2+-site positions mean identity 0.43 vs 0.59 elsewhere (p=0.037); S17 0.12, I51 0.12, Q90 0.19; only D84 (0.94) and R88 (0.88) conserved, forming a 2.74 A salt bridge','Opisthokonta, Archaeplastida, Discoba, Alveolata, Stramenopila','high; 16 sequences, paralogue assignment by alignment score'),
 ('this work (Shrake-Rupley SASA)','structural/computational','refutes','Loop tips are basic and hydrophobic as in Ca2+-independent C2 domains','Loops 17-24, 45-52, 80-93: 3 acidic, 2 basic, net -1, mean RSA 0.31, two exposed hydrophobic tips (I51 RSA 0.80, F86 0.71); 15 A cap has 2 K/R, fewest of 11 C2 structures (panel 3-6)','human B9D2 AlphaFold model','moderate; cap net charge alone does not separate B9D2 sharply from the panel'),
 ('this work (conservation vs distance)','evolutionary/computational','qualifies','The loop pole is a constrained interaction face in the complex','Exposed residues within 15 A of the Ca2+ site: identity 0.48 (n=15) vs 0.51 elsewhere (n=55), Mann-Whitney p=0.719; 2 of 9 conserved exposed residues at the pole, both the D84-R88 pair','human B9D2 AlphaFold model','moderate; monomer proxy because AlphaFold-Multimer could not be run'),
 ('PMID:41165761','direct assay + mutant phenotype','competing','B9D2 contacts the TZ membrane directly','The B9 complex interacts with and anchors TMEM67 to the TZ membrane; Joubert vs Meckel B9D2 variants separate axonemal modification from ciliogenesis defects','mammalian cells, patient variants','high; a protein-mediated route to the membrane that does not need lipid binding'),
 ('PMID:32726168','interaction','supports scaffold','B9D2 acts within an obligate protein complex','MKS1-B9D2-B9D1 interaction order, interdependent TZ localisation, complex needed for the ciliary membrane diffusion barrier','mammalian cells','high'),
 ('PMID:18337471','mutant phenotype + localization','supports scaffold','B9 proteins form a complex at the ciliary base','C. elegans XBX-7, MKSR-1, MKSR-2 form a complex at the ciliary base with interdependent localisation','C. elegans sensory neurons','moderate; orthologue-level'),
 ('PMID:20713135','review/database (primary comparative analysis)','qualifies','B9 is a C2 family member','B9 proteins (Mks1/Xbx-7, Tza-1, Tza-2) delineated as a distinct branch of the C2 superfamily in an analysis of membrane-targeting domain evolution','comparative sequence analysis','moderate; the source of the lipid framing, but family membership is not a functional assay'),
 ('PROSITE PDOC51381 / InterPro IPR010796','review/database','qualifies','Database records assert lipid binding for B9-type C2','The lipid sentence in PDOC51381 describes C2 domains in general; the B9 paragraph states only that these proteins are ciliary basal-body associated. PF07162 and IPR010796 have no GO term mappings','database record','high for the database state as retrieved 2026-11-24'),
 ('QuickGO Q9BPU9 (56 annotations)','review/database','refutes','A lipid-binding annotation already exists','No GO:0008289, GO:0005543, GO:0035091 or GO:0005509. MF limited to GO:0005515 (7 IPI) and GO:0043015 (IEA/ISS). GO:0016020 membrane is IEA GO_REF:0000107 only','database record','high'),
], columns=['citation','evidence_type','direction','claim_tested','key_finding','context','confidence_and_limitations'])

for nm,df in [('evidence_matrix',ev),('go_decision_table',go),('c2_comparison_panel',panel)]:
    df.to_csv(f'{nm}.csv',index=False); print(f'wrote {nm}.csv  ({df.shape[0]} rows)')
print(); print(go[['GO_id','term','aspect','recommended_action']].to_string(index=False))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.6))
col={'Ca2+-dependent':'#2b6cb0','Ca2+-independent':'#dd6b20','B9-type':'#c53030'}
sub=panel.dropna(subset=['carboxylO_8A'])
ax[0].bar(range(len(sub)),sub['carboxylO_8A'],color=[col[c] for c in sub['class']])
ax[0].set_xticks(range(len(sub))); ax[0].set_xticklabels(sub['protein'],rotation=55,ha='right',fontsize=8)
ax[0].set_ylabel('Asp/Glu carboxylate oxygens within 8 A\nof the superposed C2 Ca2+ site')
ax[0].set_title('B9-type C2 domains have lost the aspartate cluster\n(Ca2+-dependent vs B9-type, Mann-Whitney p=%.4f)'%p1,fontsize=10)
sub2=panel.dropna(subset=['basic_cap_15A'])
ax[1].scatter(sub2['basic_cap_15A'],sub2['hydrophobic_cap_15A'],c=[col[c] for c in sub2['class']],s=90,edgecolor='k',linewidth=.4)
for _,r in sub2.iterrows():
    ax[1].annotate(r['protein'].split()[0],(r['basic_cap_15A'],r['hydrophobic_cap_15A']),fontsize=7,xytext=(4,3),textcoords='offset points')
ax[1].set_xlabel('Lys + Arg within 15 A of the Ca2+ site'); ax[1].set_ylabel('hydrophobic residues within 15 A')
ax[1].set_title('B9D2 has the fewest basic residues at the loop pole\nof the 11 C2 structures measured',fontsize=10)
hand=[plt.Line2D([0],[0],marker='s',ls='',color=v,label=k) for k,v in col.items()]
ax[1].legend(handles=hand,fontsize=8,loc='lower right')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
